_meta.scenario: Unclassified dispute — situation does not cleanly fit into 'fare' or 'service'. E.g., customer claims they already paid but driver says they did not. Use 'other' type and document the details fully so the support team can investigate.
_meta.note: Use 'other' only when dispute_type cannot be determined at time of reporting. Support team will reclassify during investigation.
